item.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Has Been Updated To Ver. 1.1.0, Here Are The Full Patch Notes

description.p: You and Mii.Nintendo Switch Sports Resort releases tomorrow (22nd October), and Nintendo is making sure that launch day goes smoothly by releasing its very first update.The ver. 1.1.0 update is now available. As is often the case with these launch-day jobbies, its purpose is mainly to enable all of the online modes so everyone can play some non-local multiplayer right from the jump. That said, the update also introduces a Mii frequency adjuster, where you can choose how often your Miis appear in offline competitive sports.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: A Permanent Pokémon Store Is Finally Coming To London

description.p: The first of "several" outside Asia.After years of us leaving the pop-up shop at the European International Championships and wondering, "why isn't this a permanent thing?", it seems our wishes have finally been answered.The Pokémon Company has today announced that a "permanent, physical Pokémon store" is set to open in London. The store (not referred to as a 'Pokémon Center' in TPC's official statement, interestingly) will open by 2029, and will offer "a variety of exclusive merchandise and one-of-a-kind experiences for Trainers of all ages".Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Award-Winning Indie Horror 'Mouthwashing' Finally Arrives On Switch This Month

description.p: Eye spy.Creepy space horror Mouthwashing became something of an indie sensation when it launched back in 2024. After racking up over 500,000 Steam sales, publisher Critical Reflex announced that a Switch version was in the works and now (a year on from that announcement), we finally have a release date.As revealed in yesterday's Xbox Showcase, Mouthwashing will launch on the Switch eShop on 29th October — yep, as in next week. It's already available to pre-order on the North American storefront, in fact, for $12.99. We've noticed that the store lists its release date as 10th October, but we're sure that's just a typo (we've reached out to Critical Reflex just to double-check). Read the full article on nintendolife.com
